definitions.weighted_response_s: severity-weighted mean ETA of the first approved decision per need (served needs only)
definitions.critical_under_8min_share: critical needs whose first approved ETA <= 480 s; unmet counts as a miss
definitions.first_decision_unmet: needs left unmet in the first approved plan that contained them
definitions.final_unmet_quanta: unmet demand quanta in the last approved plan
definitions.reassignments: committed units moved to a different need while their need stayed open
definitions.mean_uncovered_zones: mean per replan of reserve zone/resource pairs not covered
definitions.replan_ms: wall time of Planner.recompute (state read, candidate routing, solve, publish)
